title: Kipper pâté with orange on toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Kippers, crème fraîche, horseradish sauce, oranges and bread are all things a grandparent would have kept in the cupboard or fridge.

supermarket.reason: Kipper fillets, crème fraîche, horseradish, oranges and wholemeal bread are all everyday-priced Tesco staples.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a kettle, bowls, a fork, a grater, a knife and a toaster, and the technique is easy.

works.reason: Jugging 300g kippers and mashing them with 100g crème fraîche gives plenty of well-seasoned pâté for eight slices, which suits four as a hearty snack.

honest_times.reason: A 5-minute soak, then skinning, boning, zesting, mashing and toasting fits comfortably in 15 minutes.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient is used and matches its id, and the steps use nothing that isn't listed.

seasonal_feel.reason: Smoky kippers with February citrus on hot toast suit a cold afternoon, and the kipper is clearly the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: It reads as clear, friendly British English with practical tips such as feeling for bones and leaving out the salt.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oily fish on wholemeal toast with fresh orange makes a filling snack of real food.
